Thanks Sofia — good questions. Looping in Dev (Integration Lead) and Connor (SE) to provide the technical answers and proposed owners from Redwood. Answers (brief):

- Streaming: we generally recommend long-lived HTTP/2 streams (server-sent events / chunked responses) for mobile-first apps because they work reliably behind common mobile-network proxies and keep client reconnection logic simple. For ultra-low latency and bi-directional binary channels WebRTC is an option; we can scope that if you expect sub-70ms RT from mobile.
- Tool-calling: Redwood supports both models: we can host a proxy layer (redwood-managed tool endpoints) or call your APIs directly. For security-conscious customers like you, the typical pattern is to deploy a lightweight adapter inside your VPC (Private deployment) and provide signed callbacks — avoids exposing internal APIs publicly.
- Structured outputs: we provide recommended JSON schema templates for common use-cases (classification, entity extraction, table outputs). I'll attach integration_spec.md with schema examples and an example transformer for your analytics pipeline.

Dev / Connor — can you confirm owners and call out any infra/security dependencies? Also please add estimated effort in days for each milestone so Sofia can coordinate with Diego.

Marissa
